summary: Curry County site on the Siskiyou NF: a 1920 patrolman station, a July 1920 trail item, and a Pebble Point name elsewhere. Listed as gone; no source describes it today.

facts.status_note: The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the Pebble Point site as gone; firelookout.com calls it abandoned.

events.note: Used as a patrolman station, with C.E. Criteser as patrolman
Siskiyou Bulletin, July 1920: a start made on the Pebble Hill Trail

evidence.supports: 1920 patrolman station with C.E. Criteser as patrolman

evidence.quote: Have also made a start on my Pebble Hill Trail. have a good grade, nothing over fifteen percent

notes_for_editor: Probable duplicate of us-or-pebble-point: FFLA gives 42.51827, -124.09936, about 0.55 km from this record, same agency, different name. Consider merging the two. The only dated use is 1920 (patrolman station, trail work); the 1930s date on firelookout.com has no year. FFLA type is Unknown. The Forest Lookouts page gives no build or end date. A peak database listing for Pebble Hill (3,009 ft, same coordinates) turned up in search but was not read; it describes the peak, not the lookout. Brief status unknown was set to gone from the FFLA row. No access or visit information found.
